paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism

model_annotation: This donut-style pie chart represents the distribution of different categories of "Stimuli Type," as indicated by the bold, prominently displayed text situated within the central open space of the chart. The chart is divided into a total of nine distinct slices. Proceeding clockwise from the top right, the segments are presented as follows: a dark red slice labeled "Draft/Other" representing 28.5%, a dark mauve slice labeled "Organizational Report" at 8.8%, a lighter mauve slice labeled "Event Posting" at 8.8%, a dark navy blue slice labeled "Interview" at 10.2%, a medium blue slice labeled "Organizational Website" at 6.6%, a dark green slice labeled "External News Article" at 13.1%, a light green slice labeled "Social Media Post" at 1.5%, a mustard yellow slice labeled "Press Release" at 21.9%, and a very thin orange slice labeled "Intra-agency news article" at 0.7%. The graphic does not include a separate legend, nor are the percentage labels placed inside the slices; instead, both the category labels and their exact percentages are positioned externally, directly adjacent to their corresponding segments. The slices are separated by thin white borders, and none of the segments are visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting. Visually, the segments do not appear to be ordered in any consistent ascending or descending sequence based on their size.
